Auto-answered by the orchestrator clarify-respond workflow.

I'm answering with Q1: A and Q2: B. Q1 and Q2 are compatible: B is the only Q2 option that conflicts with nothing.

One thing I found changes the picture: on `main`, `workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py` line 2279 already has the new live lookup (`pull_requests = query_pull_requests(slug, branch, cwd)`). The matching changelog fragment, `changelog.d/6641-merge-guard-push-fresh-pr-state.md`, is also on `main`. So the template change came from #6641 on `main`, not only from #6647. I couldn't see whether `main`'s own live hook matches, because this checkout has no `.claude/` directory.

DECISIONS:
Q1: A
Q2: B

RATIONALE:
Q1: The red `CI` check (run 37866800853) is on PR #6647's branch `ai/issue-6635` at `da50a4874bdc`, so the fix has to land there for that PR to pass. Option B's reasoning ("main does not have #6647's template change yet") is wrong, because `main` already has the new lookup. But `main` targets nothing that is currently failing, so A is still the right branch. Option C would leave the drift to a review loop that is not allowed to write this file.
Q2: The pipeline deliberately keeps AI editors away from this hook, which runs on the host as a safety check:
- The review sandbox explicitly excludes `.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py` (`scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py:121`).
- CI deliberately never prepares the live copies of security hooks. Their committed live copies must already match the templates, "even when the editor cannot write the live file".

Option A would get around both guards using a grant raised from an issue built out of CI-log text, which is untrusted. Option C would drop the security fix that #6641 already merged to `main`. So a person makes the byte-for-byte sync commit, and the pipeline only checks and closes.

EXECUTION PLAN (required for any non-letter decision):
(none; both decisions are letters)
Notes for the planner and implementer when following Q1:A + Q2:B:
- Add `Integration branch: ai/issue-6635` so any follow-up work stacks onto PR #6647.
- Do not write to `.claude/**` or `workflow-templates/.claude/**`. Do not change `tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py`, `tests/test_claude_template_live_parity.py`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml` lines 394-401, or `scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py`.
- The human operator should first check whether `main`'s `.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py` matches `main`'s template:
  - If it does not match, sync it on `main` first, so `main`'s own CI stays green, and then merge `main` into `ai/issue-6635`.
  - If it does match, copy the template over the live hook on `ai/issue-6635`, keeping the executable mode.
- Then the pipeline reruns `tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py` and `tests/test_claude_template_live_parity.py`, confirms `CI / lint` is green on PR #6647's new head, and closes this issue. It must not use an auto-close keyword against any `ai:orchestrator-tracking` issue.
